title: Accessing and checking a list suffix
statement: Define a recursive operation on Boolean lists, with inputs a list $a$, a list $w$, a Boolean $q$, and an optional Boolean $r$, whose value is an optional Boolean. If $a$ is empty, the value is undefined when $r$ is false; otherwise it is the Boolean that holds exactly when $q$ is true and $w$ is empty. If $a=b::a'$, the value is the result of applying the operation to $a'$, the tail of $w$, the conjunction of $q$ with the condition that the head of $w$ equals $b$, and the option containing $b$.
hypotheses_covered: the inputs are Boolean lists $a,w$, a Boolean $q$, and an optional Boolean $r$
